page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2.2xlarge is an x86_64 storage-focused virtual instance running on KVM. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, it offers 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of memory, providing an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio, alongside 1919 GB of local SSD storage and a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps. The processor features a 33 MB L3 cache and supports AVX, AVX-512F, AES, and FMA instruction sets.

In synthetic CPU benchmarks, the ecs.i2.2xlarge records a PassMark CPU score of 6991.89 and a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 5883.4, reflecting modest raw processing capability typical of older Intel Xeon architectures. Memory write bandwidth for large blocks reaches 35.45 GB/sec, while uncached read bandwidth measures 39.23 GB/sec. Application benchmarks indicate solid operational throughput for memory-resident workloads, achieving 6.06 million operations per second on Redis SET operations, while small model (135M parameter) prompt processing reaches 442.93 tokens per second.

The instance trades raw CPU performance for high local SSD storage density and elevated RAM allocations per core. While single-threaded compression and modern medium-scale LLM inference show performance constraints, the combination of 1919 GB local SSD storage and 64.0 GB memory makes this instance cost-effective for localized caching, transactional databases, log processing, and I/O-intensive data workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2.2xlarge is a storage-focused instance equipped with 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores, 64.0 GB of memory, and 1919 GB of direct-attached SSD local storage. Driven by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor at 2.5 GHz with AVX-512 support, the system provides an 8.0 GB RAM per vCPU ratio and 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmarks show a PassMark CPU score of 6991.89 and Redis SET throughput of 6.06 million operations per second, alongside large block memory write bandwidth of 35.45 GB/sec. While CPU compute and single-threaded compression scores remain modest relative to newer architectures, the inclusion of dedicated local SSD storage paired with a high memory allocation delivers balanced resource density for localized database engines, memory caching systems, log indexing, and I/O-sensitive transactional processing tasks.
